name: The Gate's Judgment
description: Universal trial arena where all players prove their worth to their chosen deity before entering their faction campaign. Three concentric rings: tutorial combat, ability puzzle, Hollow Wretch boss.

layoutDetails.outerRing: Entry zone — tutorial movement and basic combat
layoutDetails.middleRing: Ability trial — faction-specific mechanic test (same map, different puzzle per faction)

universalElements: Map layout and geometry identical for all factions
Healing shrine between middle and inner rings

factionSpecificElements.environmentTint: Arena subtly shifts to match chosen faction color palette
factionSpecificElements.deityDialogue: Chosen deity speaks unique voice lines during trial
factionSpecificElements.victoryBanner: Faction banner rises in arena upon completion

postTrial.step1: Gate opens fully — cinematic of faction realm revealed
postTrial.step2: Deity formally accepts player as champion
postTrial.step3: Campaign Mission 1 unlocks for chosen faction
postTrial.step4: Player accesses faction campaign map and mission registry
